repair_actions: Disassemble the pump portion of the motor pump set.
Visually inspect the impeller, casing ring, and casing cover for signs of wear, damage, or foreign material.
Measure the clearance between the impeller and the casing ring, and between the impeller and the casing cover using appropriate gauges.
embedding_text: Impeller-Casing Clearance clearance 0.5 mm Reduced water output Low water pressure
